mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, last_heartbeat_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now} OR lease_owner = #{owner})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_session WHERE (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND retryable = 1 AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now} AND attempt_count < max_attempts) ORDER BY updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{error}, failure_type = #{failureType}, retryable = 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}

UPDATE agent_session SET status = #{status}, final_summary = #{summary}, error_message = #{error}, finished_at = #{now}, retryable = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE agent_session SET status = #{status}, final_summary = #{summary}, error_message = #{error}, finished_at = #{now}, retryable = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_turn (id, session_id, turn_no, event_type, summary, created_at) SELECT #{id}, #{sessionId}, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(turn_no) FROM agent_turn t WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId}), 0) + 1, #{eventType}, #{summary}, #{createdAt} FROM dual
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, turn_no AS turnNo, event_type AS eventType, summary, created_at AS createdAt FROM agent_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY turn_no

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_tool_call WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'STARTED' AND tool_code IN #{code}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('CREATED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','WAITING_INPUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCnt, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCnt FROM agent_session WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode}

SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, tool_call_id AS toolCallId, tool_code AS toolCode, arguments_json AS argumentsJson, result_summary AS resultSummary, status, duration_ms AS durationMs, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM agent_tool_call WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY started_at
